text: Yes, deforestation occurred on this asset in 2023. The evidence shows a tree-cover loss event of 0.7 hectares, which is 1.2% of the asset area. This event was observed by the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13) and corroborated by the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 dataset, which mapped the area as forest in 2020. The event area was primarily planted forest (0.4 hectares) with some unmapped forest (0.3 hectares). Although there was also a loss of 0.4 hectares in patches under 0.5 hectares in 2023, this was not counted as an event.
